jobs.title: AI Response Evaluator
jobs.location: France, Japan, Turkey, Vietnam, Mexico, Norway
jobs.jd_full:
iMerit is looking for detail oriented analysts to evaluate and rank AI generated responses to image based prompts. You will judge answers on accuracy, relevance, clarity, conciseness, safety, localization, and how well they follow the user's instructions, then explain your reasoning in writing.
Much of the job comes down to this: look at the image, look at what the model said about it, and decide whether the two actually match.

What you will do

  • Interpret conversational context and identify what the user really wanted

  • Rate and rank responses against defined quality criteria

  • Compare multiple answers and explain in writing why one wins

  • Verify factual claims using approved research sources

  • Flag tasks that cannot be reliably assessed rather than guessing

What you bring:

  • Strong critical thinking and sound judgment in ambiguous cases

  • Solid research skills and attention to detail

  • Excellent reading comprehension

  • Self direction and the discipline to hit deadlines without supervision

Good to know

  • Independent contractor engagement for the length of the project. 

  • Fully remote and flexible.

  • You choose your hours as long as volume and deadlines are met.

  • Task volume varies with project demand.

jobs.title: Project Manager, Design Team
jobs.jd_full:
About Us

ManyPixels gives SMEs, agencies, and marketing teams around the world direct access to a team of designers. No freelancer roulette, no bloated agency retainers. Since 2018, we have delivered 150,000+ designs to businesses across the globe, and we are proud to be one of the most trusted on-demand graphic design services online.

Our team is fully distributed across Europe and Asia, while most of our clients call the US home. That mix is part of what makes ManyPixels work: different time zones, different backgrounds, one shared standard for great design.

Curious what we do? Take a look:

About the Role

You will manage a team of 10+ designers and a portfolio of 100+ clients. The work is varied by design: logos one hour, landing pages the next, and it will keep evolving as we grow.

What You'll Own

  • Workload management. Every incoming task, whether it's a logo, a landing page, or an illustration, needs to land with the designer best suited for it. You will make sure nobody is underworked or drowning, and that we always hit our promised 24-hour delivery.
  • Quality control. You are the last set of eyes before anything reaches a client. You will check every finished task against the brief, send back what needs work, and act as the final approver on your team's output.
  • People management. Your team is your responsibility. That includes leave requests, internal and external communication, problem resolution, and making sure our SOPs are followed, not just filed away.
  • Performance reviews. With support from the management team, you will run monthly and annual performance reviews for everyone on your team.
  • Training. You will lead one-on-one and group training on everything from onboarding to customer communication to time management, helping your team grow as they go.
  • Client relationships. Our designers communicate with clients directly every day. When things get complex, you step in by chat, email, or video call to keep the relationship and the project on track.

Our Ideal Candidate

  • At least 3 years of experience in a leadership or management role. This is non-negotiable.
  • Strong knowledge of graphic and/or web design; you can tell good work from mediocre work in seconds.
  • Comfortable across tools like Google Workspace, Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, and Canva.
  • Experience with team tools like Slack, Asana, and Notion.
  • Working knowledge of AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, or Gemini to work smarter and faster.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and tight deadlines without dropping anything.
  • A confident, direct communicator who can deliver hard feedback without damaging the relationship.
  • A fast learner who treats change as normal, not as a disruption.
  • Excellent written and spoken English; you will be the voice our clients hear when it matters most.
  • Available to work US Eastern Time, 9 AM to 6 PM, without exception.

This Might Not Be for You If

  • You need frequent check-ins to stay on track.
  • You avoid confronting underperformance.
  • You are looking for a predictable 9-to-5 with no surprises.

What We Offer

  • A full-time, 100% remote role.
  • 20 days of paid time off per year.
  • Competitive salary, depending on experience, skills, and results.
  • Real ownership over your team and portfolio from day one.

This is a full-time position: 40 hours per week, 8 hours per day, Monday to Friday.

ManyPixels is a remote-first, equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds.

Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: Strategy & Operations Lead — Korea
jobs.jd_full:
About the Team

The APAC team is responsible for bringing OpenAI’s mission, products, and partnerships to life across one of the company’s most strategically important regions. As we scale our presence across Asia-Pacific, we are building a regional operating model that enables strong local execution, consistent global alignment, and long-term impact across businesses, products, markets, and functions.

About the Role

We are looking for a Strategy & Operations Lead to lead and scale operational excellence in Korea. Reporting to the General Manager, Korea, this leader will work hand in hand with the General Manager to translate global strategy into regional execution, ensure operating discipline across markets and functions, and help the business scale with consistency, speed, and rigor.

This person will act as a key bridge between global leadership and regional teams, bringing clarity to priorities, building scalable operating systems, and ensuring the region is set up to deliver against ambitious business goals while keeping the long-term opportunity in mind.

This role is based in Seoul, Korea and we use a hybrid model of 3 days in office.

You’ll be responsible for:

  • Defining and implementing the Korea operating strategy in alignment with APAC & global objectives and regional priorities.

  • Driving execution across key markets, ensuring consistency while adapting to local needs, regulations, and market dynamics.

  • Partnering with global leadership to prioritize initiatives, allocate resources, and ensure strong execution in-region.

  • Establishing KPIs, reporting frameworks, and operating cadences to track performance and inform decision-making.

  • Building and optimizing scalable processes across business lines, including consumer, product, partnerships, and other key functions.

  • Identifying operational gaps and inefficiencies, and implementing continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Supporting market entry strategies and operational readiness for Korea

  • Enabling strategic partnerships through strong operational frameworks and close partnership with relevant teams.

  • Helping build a strong regional functional leadership team and ensuring the regional operating system runs smoothly and efficiently.

  • Collaborating closely across functions to drive accountability and deliver against regional goals.

  • Ensuring seamless coordination between global and regional stakeholders.

  • Acting as a central point of accountability for operational delivery across Korea.

  • Building, leading, and mentoring a high-performing regional operations team.

  • Fostering a culture of accountability, inclusion, operational rigor, and continuous learning.

  • Developing leadership bench strength across key markets and functions.

We’re looking for someone with:

  • Significant experience leading regional or international operations in a fast-scaling, complex business environment.

  • Strong strategic and operational judgment, with the ability to translate high-level goals into clear execution plans.

  • Experience operating across multiple markets, functions, and business lines, ideally within Korea.

  • A track record of building scalable operating systems, processes, metrics, and reporting frameworks.

  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills and the ability to influence senior stakeholders across global and regional teams.

  • Excellent business judgment, with a bias toward action and strong accountability for outcomes.

  • Experience supporting market expansion, operational readiness, and/or regional growth initiatives.

  • Strong people leadership skills, including experience building and developing high-performing teams.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.jd_full:
H2 Performance Consulting is subject to the Vietnam Era Veteran’s Readjustment Assistance Act as a Federal Contractor and is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer and strives to build a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran status or disability status. Additionally, as mandated under Executive order 12989, H2 is required to verify employment eligibility of selected candidates through the Department of Labor’s - E-Verify.

H2 Performance Consulting (H2), a high-growth technology firm, is seeking a Senior Project Manager to support a U.S. government client. The Senior Project Manager will lead complex Federal projects, programs, and transformation initiatives from planning through implementation and closeout. The position integrates mission requirements, scope, schedule, cost, quality, risk, resources, governance, contractor performance, and stakeholder decisions to deliver measurable outcomes within the Federal operating environment. This is a fully remote position supporting a government client. The position requires U.S. citizenship and an active Public Trust clearance at the time of application. This position is contingent upon contract award, final staffing requirements, security eligibility, certification requirements, and customer approval, where applicable.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Plan and lead complex projects or programs involving multiple workstreams, offices, bureaus, commands, contractors, or stakeholder organizations.

  • Establish the project management approach, integrated schedule, work breakdown structure, governance cadence, performance baseline, quality controls, and reporting processes.

  • Manage scope, schedule, cost, staffing, dependencies, risks, issues, assumptions, decisions, changes, deliverables, acceptance, and closeout.

  • Translate contract, statutory, policy, program, technical, and stakeholder requirements into executable plans, milestones, backlogs, and assignments.

  • Lead multidisciplinary Government and contractor teams and coordinate the work of functional, technical, data, cybersecurity, acquisition, financial, and operational specialists.

  • Facilitate program reviews, integrated project teams, governance forums, risk reviews, sprint reviews, and executive decision sessions.

  • Develop forecasts, corrective action plans, alternatives, decision papers, executive briefings, and Government-ready status reports.

  • Maintain requirements and deliverable traceability and ensure work products are accurate, timely, defensible, and contractually compliant.

  • Support implementation, organizational change, communications, training, transition, adoption, benefits realization, and sustainment planning.

  • Align project objectives, outcomes, and acceptance criteria with agency mission, policy, acquisition strategy, funding, and operational priorities.

  • Develop and maintain integrated project plans, schedules, resource forecasts, risk and issue registers, action logs, decision logs, and performance dashboards.

  • Monitor progress using tools like GitHub or Jira with appropriate predictive, adaptive, Agile, or hybrid delivery methods and recommend timely management action when performance varies from the baseline.

  • Coordinate dependencies among policy, business processes, workforce, data, technology, security, privacy, accessibility, procurement, and deployment activities.

  • Manage communications with Government leads, contracting personnel, executives, end users, vendors, and partner organizations.

  • Protect procurement-sensitive, proprietary, personally identifiable, controlled, unclassified, and other sensitive information in accordance with applicable requirements.

  • Promote practical continuous improvement while maintaining accountability for scope, decisions, approvals, and outcomes.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution in business, public administration, project management, engineering, information systems, or related field; master’s degree preferred.

  • 10+ years of progressively responsible project, program, operations, or management-consulting experience.

  • 10+ years supporting Federal civilian, defense, intelligence, military, or comparable public-sector organizations.

  • 10+ years leading complex projects, major workstreams, multidisciplinary teams, or transformation initiatives.

  • Demonstrated experience managing scope, schedule, cost, risk, quality, staffing, stakeholders, and contract deliverables.

  • Demonstrated ability to advise senior Government leaders and convert complex information into decisions and executable actions.

  • Documented results improving mission effectiveness, timeliness, quality, cost, compliance, customer experience, or workforce performance.

  • U.S. citizenship required.

  • Active Public Trust clearance required at the time of application.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Project Management Professional, FAC-P/PM, DAWIA Level III Program Management, Certified ScrumMaster, PMI Agile Certified Practitioner, or comparable credential.

  • Lean Six Sigma, Prosci Change Management, ITIL, or comparable process, change, or service management credential.

  • Experience managing firm-fixed-price, time-and-materials, cost-reimbursement, multiple-award, task-order, or performance-based Federal work.

  • Experience with integrated master schedules, earned value concepts, Agile delivery, product roadmaps, requirements traceability, quality assurance, and executive governance.

  • Experience supporting Cabinet-level departments, defense organizations, independent agencies, or multi-agency initiatives.

H2 Performance Consulting offers competitive benefits to include health insurance, vision/dental insurance, paid time off, holiday pay, and 401K.

jobs.title: Lead Editor Product Manager
jobs.jd_full:
About the role

Descript’s script-based editing features are at the heart of why creators trust us for their highest-stakes content. Product launches. Client interviews. Marketing campaigns. Content that represents them to their audiences.

As Lead Product Manager of the Narrative Editing team, you’ll own how users capture, edit, and perfect their stories. You’ll shape the script-first editing that makes video as simple as a document, the recording and writing tools that let users create without leaving Descript, and the AI regeneration features that make edits feel seamless and natural.

This is an opportunity to shape features that professional creators depend on while working with cutting-edge AI, a product users love, and a small, collaborative team where your impact is immediate and visible.

What you’ll do

  • Develop a deep understanding of our customers, their creative goals, and the evolving AI video landscape — and use those insights to guide the editor roadmap
  • Bring Descript’s taste for great video into interactions and defaults, so creators naturally produce polished, professional work
  • Continuously expand our editing capabilities with frontier AI technology by partnering with our AI Research team, launching features like video regeneration and automatic speaker identification
  • Own the recording, script generation, and translation flows that help users achieve their end-to-end video workflows directly in Descript
  • Ensure Descript scales reliably for larger teams and more complex workflows

Who you are

  • You’ve built deceptively powerful tools: You have 5 or more years of product management experience shipping creative tools or workflow products that feel simple enough for everyone, but scale to handle sophisticated use cases. You are a systems-minded product thinker who excels at designing intuitive experiences for complex, end-to-end workflows.
  • You start with the customer: Plenty of “AI products” start with the technology and they all suck. You care deeply about understanding customers, and have experience in doing customer discovery and defining features that solve real problems.
  • You are a fog sculptor: There are aspects to our editor and its design that do not have real competitors yet. The product intuition and design conventions have not been decided. You are attracted to ambiguous problems, know how to ask smart questions, and translate ideas into action.
  • You care about craft: Our product is not a hype machine that runs on empty promises and vaporware. We think our product will be successful because people love to use it. That means you sweat the details. But without the sweat, because you aren’t stressed out.
  • You are funny, creative, maybe kind of weird: Ok, this isn’t a hard requirement but Descript is kind of a quirky place and the people who love it tend to _like_ that about working here. So, just want to drop a hint early on. Also, the sense of humor is important because even though we take our work seriously it’s still just, like, video creation and editing. We aren’t flying rockets into space so let’s all have a good time.

The base salary range for this role is $225,000 - $290,000. Final offer amounts will carefully consider multiple factors, including prior experience, expertise, location, level, and may vary from the amount above.

About Descript

Descript is building a simple, intuitive, fully-powered editing tool for video and audio — an editing tool built for the age of AI. We are a team of 150 and the backing of some of the world’s greatest investors (OpenAI, Andreessen Horowitz, Redpoint Ventures, Spark Capital).

Descript is the special company that’s in possession of both product market fit and the raw materials (passionate user community, great product, large market) for growth, but is still early enough that each new employee has a measurable influence on the direction of the company.

Benefits include a generous healthcare package, 401k matching program, catered lunches, and flexible vacation time. Our headquarters are located in the Mission District of San Francisco, CA. We’re hiring for a mix of remote roles and hybrid roles.  For those who are remote, we have a handful of opportunities throughout the year for in person collaboration.  For our hybrid roles, we’re flexible, and you’re an adult—we don’t expect or mandate that you’re in the office every day. We do believe there are valuable and serendipitous moments of discovery and collaboration that come from working together in person.

Descript is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We believe in actively building a team rich in diverse backgrounds, experiences, and opinions to better allow our employees, products, and community to thrive.

jobs.title: Business Operations / Project Manager
jobs.jd_full:
About MonetizeMore

MonetizeMore is a global pioneer in ad technology, powering ad monetization for over 150,000 websites and apps globally. We combine proprietary technology with sophisticated optimization strategies to secure and maximize publisher revenue. We are a 100% remote, culture-first organization driven by four core values: Integrity, Enterprising, Kaizen (Continuous Improvement), and Collaboration. We empower our global team with absolute location autonomy and flexible global schedules. We care about the impact you deliver, not the hours you log on.

About the Role

The company is seeking an experienced, systems-driven Business Operations / Project Manager with a strong AdTech Background to transform informal workflows into owned, structured, and scalable operational systems. As the primary connective layer across departments, this role focuses on process kaizen, SOP governance, and end-to-end operational enablement—ensuring teams execute efficiently without reinventing processes.

The Business Operations / Project Manager will manage the central project management infrastructure and partner directly with Product and executive leadership. Key responsibilities include preparing cross-functional teams for product launches, streamlining enterprise client workflows, and establishing organization-wide standards for accountability and visibility. As a data- and AI-fluent operator, the candidate will design structured spreadsheet models, integrate AI tools to accelerate documentation, and continuously optimize reporting systems.

Core Responsibilities

1. Process Kaizen & SOP Governance

  • ### Run a continuous improvement cadence across the process landscape; killing, combining, or improving SOPs weekly. Own the process vault and ensure every process is signed off by its owner and governed for adoption, not just documented.

2. Project Management & Visibility

  • ### Own and maintain internal Notion project management tracker; ensuring all projects, to-dos, and tickets are tracked, visible, and actioned. Drive adoption beyond the department, building the systems foundation for a company-wide model with long-term integration into business line weekly meetings, as aligned with product operating model.

3. Product Rollout Support

  • ### Support product release processes, structuring the operational side of launches so teams are enabled ahead of go-live. Work closely with Group Product Manager to formalize this process as a repeatable model.

4. Cross-Departmental & Enterprise Client Enablement

  • ### Act as an operational connective layer across business lines and enterprise client workflows; surfacing blockers, coordinating data and documentation needs, and keeping cross-functional commitments visible and actioned.

5. Data & Spreadsheet Management

  • ### Own data pulls and spreadsheet-based reporting for departmental initiatives; Building and maintaining structured, reliable, and scalable systems and models that others can use without re-deriving logic. Comfort with formulas, structured data, and dashboard hygiene is core to the role.

Who You Are

  • The Experienced Operator: You have 4+ years of experience in a process, project management, or business operations role. Ad tech, SaaS, high-data-volume or WordPress ecosystem experience is a plus, as is experience working with Salesforce (SFDC).
  • The Systems Builder: You default to structure, and you know the difference between owning a process and doing the work inside it. Given a messy or untracked workstream, your instinct is to define ownership, standardize steps, and build the scaffolding (trackers, SOPs, cadences) that lets other functions execute reliably.
  • Data- and AI-Fluent: You’re comfortable pulling, cleaning, and structuring data in spreadsheets without hand-holding, and you’ve used AI tools in your actual workflow to speed up documentation and process work.
  • Comfortable with Ambiguity: You can walk into an undefined workstream, ask the right questions, and leave it with clear ownership and a repeatable process.
  • Direct Communicator: You flag problems early and plainly. You don’t let a stalled ticket or an unsigned SOP sit quietly.

What We Offer

  • True Flexibility: Work from anywhere in the world with an flexible schedule that fits your lifestyle.
  • Professional Development: Continuous opportunities for career growth, learning allowances, and direct impact on a fast growing company.

jobs.title: Program Manager - Informatics
jobs.jd_full:
About Blue Water Thinking

Guided by our principles of value generation, continuous innovation, customer-centricity, and vested collaboration, Blue Water Thinking proudly supports our Federal clients in achieving their Agency goals.

Founded by a decorated twenty-eight year Veteran of the United States Army, Blue Water Thinking understands and supports the mission of our Nation’s war fighters, Veterans, their families and caretakers.

Leveraging our executive team’s military experience and private and public sector consulting expertise, Blue Water Thinking takes an integrated “one-team” approach and brings to bear best-fit solutions,  thought leadership, and grit to meet our client’s transformational needs.

Fueled by our values of integrity, respect, professionalism, stewardship and customer service, the Blue Water Thinking team understands the power of the human connection, collaboration, humility and loyalty to one another, our clients and industry partners.

Lastly, our formula for success is simple:  Build something good, take care of our people, keep our clients satisfied, nurture our work ethic and reputation, build long-lasting partnerships, enjoy what we do and give back as much as possible.

Job Description:

We are seeking a seasoned Program Manager, Informatics to actively lead strategic health informatics initiatives. This role is ideal for a professional with deep expertise in health informatics, SAFe®’s Lean Agile principles and practices, and organizational change. The successful candidate will leverage SAFe® framework to drive feature delivery and deliver quality products and services. You will be responsible for leading contract’s programmatic resources to ensure features are acceptable, of high quality, and meet industry standards. If you have a strong background in SAFe®’s Lean Agileand a passion for making a positive impact on Veterans’ lives, we invite you to join our team.

As a Principal Program Manager, Informatics supporting the Department of Veterans Affairs, you will play a vital role in managing projects that drive consistent quality of care across the VHA enterprise. Your expertise in program and project management and ability to develop innovative solutions will contribute to the successful completion of critical projects. Join our team and help make a difference in the lives of Veterans and their families.

  • Identify and mitigate risks to portfolio
  • Develop and manage project plans, budget, schedules and deliverables across multiple teams.

  • Monitor project progress, adjusting as necessary to ensure timely and cost-effective completion.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment of project goals and objectives.

  • Minimum of 15 years of experience in healthcare consulting, program management, or healthcare analytics.
  • Expertise in clinical informatics and experience managing diverse IT projects
  • Experience with and demonstrate understanding of SAFe®’s Lean Agile principles and practices.

  • Proficiency in project management software.
  • Exceptional communication, leadership, and stakeholder engagement skills. MS Office suite skills (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Project, Visio, Outlook, etc.)

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience working with government/civilian agencies or in the health care industry.

Eligibility:

  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain the required federal public trust clearance for this role

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager [Remote-US]
jobs.jd_full:
To help keep everyone safe, we encourage all applicants to pay close attention to protect themselves during their job search. When applying for a position online you are at risk of being targeted by malicious actors looking for personal data. Please be aware we will only reach out via email using the domain quanata.com. Anything that does not match those domains should be ignored and considered a security risk.

About Us

Quanata is on a mission to help ensure a better world through context-based insurance solutions. We are an exceptional, customer centered team with a passion for creating innovative technologies, digital products, and brands. We blend some of the best Silicon Valley talent and cutting-edge thinking with the long-term backing of leading insurer, State Farm.

Learn more about us and our work at quanata.com

Our Team

Quanata, LLC is an insurance technology innovation company that engineers advanced risk prediction and prevention solutions, develops risk-focused acquisition capabilities, and builds/supports a full-stack, flexible, digital & increasingly AI-native insurance platform. This helps our primary clients, State Farm and HiRoad Assurance Company, adapt to evolving market needs. Quanata, LLC is wholly owned and funded by State Farm.

As a company that prioritizes an inclusive and positive culture, we believe the core of our success is in hiring talented people — across disciplines — who want to help us make a quantifiable impact.

The Role

We’re looking for an accomplished, well-rounded Senior Product Manager to join the Quanata Product Team. You’ll bring experience building insurance platforms and a strong understanding of the policy lifecycle, integrations, data modeling, pricing, and underwriting.

In this role, you’ll lead empowered, cross-functional teams in solving meaningful customer and business problems. Your focus will be on shaping product vision and strategy while translating that direction into measurable business outcomes.

You’ll work at the intersection of product, technology, data, and insurance—navigating complex problems, making evidence-based decisions, and helping teams deliver scalable, high-quality products and services.

Your Day-to-Day

  • Lead cross-functional collaboration with Engineering, Data Science, and domain teams to solve complex product and technical challenges.

  • Drive product discovery across ambiguous, multi-workstream initiatives, using qualitative and quantitative insights to test assumptions and identify high-value opportunities.

  • Own Agile product delivery, including goals, priorities, trade-offs, scope, and backlog management across Scrum and Kanban environments.

  • Evaluate build-versus-buy options and recommend approaches that balance product needs, delivery timelines, and cost.

  • Guide technical design discussions, identify dependencies, and consider performance, scalability, security, and architectural quality.

Description

About ShortPoint

ShortPoint is a design software company that helps teams build beautiful intranet sites inside Microsoft 365, SharePoint, and Microsoft Teams. Role Overview

We are seeking a hands-on Technical Product Manager to support the Product Director across the full product lifecycle. You will run and manage product meetings, turn ideas and discussions into clear, well-written user stories, create mockups with the help of modern AI tools, and keep everyone informed on the status of upcoming releases.

The ideal candidate combines strong product craft with genuine design sensibility and a solid technical foundation: you can follow engineering discussions with ease, reason about APIs and architecture, and dig into technical details when the situation calls for it. The stronger your technical depth, the better. You will bridge the gap between engineering, UI/UX design, and business priorities, and you should be comfortable working AI-first across your daily workflow.

  • AI-Assisted Design: Create wireframes and mockups using AI design and prototyping tools, and apply a strong eye for UI/UX to keep the product intuitive and polished (you will be asked to demonstrate this in the interview)

  • AI Process Improvement: Being able to contribute to our processes by utilizing AI (Claude/ChatGPT work) to analyze data, close gaps, and resolve bottlenecks.

Requirements

Required Qualifications & Experience

⚠️ Mandatory Screening Criteria: Candidates who do not meet the experience and background requirements below will not be considered.

  • Total Experience: Minimum of 3 years of hands-on product management experience specifically within software/SaaS environments

  • Industry Background: Must have direct experience working on B2B SaaS products; familiarity with Microsoft 365, SharePoint, or intranet products is a strong plus

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Fintech
jobs.jd_full:
About LeafLink

LeafLink is the largest unified B2B cannabis platform, providing licensed cannabis businesses a suite of tools to manage their business more effectively, sell or order from their favorite brands and accelerate growth. We are one platform, one solution and we’re defining the way thousands of cannabis brands, distributors, and retailers streamline their operations. With thousands of brands and retailers across 30+ markets in North America, we are setting the industry standard for how cannabis businesses grow together. LeafLink processes more than $5 billion in wholesale cannabis orders annually.

Our team, backed by funding from leading VC’s, including Founders Fund, Thrive Capital, Nosara Capital, and Lerer Hippeau is poised to define the cannabis supply chain through technology.  LeafLink was named one of Inc. 5000’s ‘Top 5000 Fastest-Growing Private Companies’; one of Fast Company’s ‘Top 10 Most Innovative Companies in Enterprise for 2020’, joining the ranks of Amazon, Slack, and VMWare; one of Built In NYC’s ‘Best Places to Work in 2021’; 2024 Fast Company’s Best WorkPlaces for Innovators for Banking, Finance, and Fintech category; 2024 Green Market Report Award for Best Fintech in cannabis - and we’re just getting started!

The Role

LeafLink is excited to bring on a Senior Product Manager to join our team to simplify and automate the regulated cannabis industry’s payments and banking challenges. As a Senior Product Manager for Fintech, you will have the opportunity to interact with executive stakeholders, top industry participants, and a wide range of financial institutions and fintech providers to build a suite of compliant payments and banking options. Further, you will work alongside an ambitious and talented team of designers, engineers, and product marketing to bring your strategy to life and get it to market.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Lead the execution of the payments product roadmap across real-time payment capabilities, advanced banking options, compliance interactions, data integration, and the frontend experience.
  • Work with key internal stakeholders as well as external partners to ensure that all payment capabilities meet the necessary KYC/AML and other key compliance requirements.
  • Articulate, own, and communicate your vision and roadmap across your pod, business unit, and company.
  • Own and be responsible for your domain’s Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to ensure product metrics align and drive the company goals.
  • Conduct market research and understand the availability of new payment technologies and B2B marketplace patterns.
  • Work with account management, business development, and marketing teams to launch payment capabilities and drive customer adoption.
  • Closely collaborate with other key product managers to ensure that payment solutions are embedded within the core Checkout flow, banking, liquidity solutions, and internal systems.
  • Manage trade-offs and prioritization between design, engineering, time-to-market, and customer experiences.
  • Partner with your pod to determine the feasibility of your vision and translate it into an executable roadmap.

What You’ll Bring to the Team

  • Customer-centric with a proven track record of developing and acting on customer insights.
  • 5+ years experience as a Product Manager working to drive innovation, workflows, and capabilities for a digital payments and/or banking-focused product or experience.
  • Experience managing a fintech ecosystem with multiple 3rd party partners within the payments and banking industry.
  • Strong understanding and exposure to the broader B2B software environment and how payments and consumers interact with new embedded finance technologies.
  • Experience building and integrating with APIs and financial data-centric products that are necessary for onboarding new bank accounts, facilitating payments, and integrating other financial products into the customer experience such as credit.
  • Experience coordinating requirements across diverse stakeholders, banking/tech partners, and development teams.
  • Ability to define opportunities and problems, collect and analyze data, establish facts, and make valid conclusions.
  • Familiarity with using research, prototypes, experimentation, and analytics to guide decision-making.
  • An interest in the cannabis industry and passion for finance, fintech, and new disruptive banking technologies.

LeafLink Perks & Benefits

  • Flexible PTO - you’re going to be working hard so enjoy time off with no cap!
  • A robust stock option plan to give our employees a direct stake in LeafLink’s success
  • 5 Days of Volunteer Time Off (VTO)- giving back is important to us and we want our employees to prioritize cultivating a better community
  • Competitive compensation and 401k
  • Comprehensive health coverage(medical, dental, vision)
  • Commuter Benefits through our Flexible Spending Account

LeafLink’s employee-centric culture has earned us a coveted spot on BuiltInNYC’s Best Places to Work for in 2021 list. Learn more about LeafLink’s history and the path to our First Billion in Wholesale Cannabis Orders here .

Base salary range

$115,000—$155,000 USD

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager - Implementation

Candid Health is looking for a Technical Program Manager - Implementation to serve as the connective tissue between our Engineering, Product, and Operations teams. This is a high-impact role designed for someone who thrives on organization and can navigate the complexities of a fast-growing platform.

You will be responsible for taking high-level business objectives and breaking them down into technical milestones, ensuring that our EPD (Engineering, Product, Design) teams are aligned with our Operations and Implementation goals. You’ll be the person who ensures that as our product grows more complex, our ability to deliver it to customers remains seamless.

  • Program Orchestration: Lead the planning and execution of large-scale initiatives. You will create the roadmaps, define the milestones, and track progress across multiple teams to ensure on-time delivery.

By identifying technical and operational bottlenecks early, you ensure that platform updates and large-scale implementations move forward without friction or surprises.

jobs.title: Program Manager (Customer Success)
jobs.jd_full:
About us

OpenZeppelin is the security standard onchain finance is built on. Founded in 2015, our mission is to accelerate the world’s transition to an open financial system, built on open standards and secured by rigorous research.

Our open-source Contract Libraries have facilitated over $35 trillion in onchain value and are used by 10 of the top 10 tokenized money market funds and 9 of the top 10 stablecoins by market cap.

We combine AI-native security tooling with deep research and a decade of audit expertise to support leading institutions and crypto-native teams shaping the next generation of digital assets like DTCC, Fidelity, Coinbase, Uniswap, Aave, the Ethereum Foundation, and many more across the full secure development lifecycle.

Please note: Always refer to OpenZeppelin’s official job page for the most accurate information about our open roles, as we have seen multiple third party job sites posting inaccurate information.

The Customer Success Team

The Customer Success Team owns full project lifecycles and client deliveries end-to-end; keeping Security Research, Secure Development, Engineering, Sales, Solutions, Executive team and clients aligned on a shared plan throughout the entire delivery. Core responsibility of the Customer Success team is client satisfaction as well as supporting any renewal discussions and ongoing partnership. The type of deliveries span across the security services work (audits, reviews, applied research), smart contract library development, web3 tooling as well as marketing and developer relationship engagements.

What you’ll be doing

  • Own the Engagement: Own the full lifecycle of strategic ecosystem accounts, from kickoff through delivery, renewal, and expansion. Serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor for each client.
  • Drive Delivery: Lead client kickoffs, manage scope through a structured change-order process, oversee end-to-end audit delivery, coordinate quality review and publishing, and proactively escalate risks to internal leadership.
  • Administer Program Governance: Operate the day-to-day governance framework for each engagement — RASCI matrices, workstream structures, and engagement models — and keep the program’s working cadence and reporting metrics current. Maintain core program artifacts (milestone plans, scope/MVP definitions, RAID logs) as the definitive source of truth, and formulate executive-level status reports for client and internal leadership.
  • Orchestrate Technical Delivery: Coordinate architecture and requirements sessions with client engineering teams and translate outcomes into actionable delivery milestones. Oversee delivery across audit and engineering teams — backlogs, sprints, and stage gates — to ensure high-quality, on-time releases, and provide formal go/no-go recommendations at key milestones. Manage technical dependencies including repository access, audit cycles, and vendor onboarding, collaborating with legal on contractual or SOW-related blockers.
  • Coordinate Third-Party Infrastructure: Synchronize delivery timelines and technical specifications with third-party infrastructure providers and partners, supporting senior leadership in commercial and contractual decision-making where needed.
  • Facilitate Dependency Mapping & Risk Management: Facilitate stakeholder coordination and dependency mapping across cross-functional teams, resolving operational blockers at the working level and escalating critical decisions to senior stakeholders. Maintain the program’s risk and compliance register and drive a regular cadence for regulatory-readiness governance and mitigation.
  • Build Account Intelligence: Maintain deep, current knowledge of each ecosystem’s goals, tech stack, governance, roadmap, and funding landscape. Anticipate client needs and surface opportunities before they are asked for.
  • Grow the Account: Partner with Sales, Secure Development, Security Services, and Growth to identify upsell opportunities, build compelling renewal narratives tied to value delivered, and contribute directly to the business unit’s recurring revenue and subscription targets. Coordinate on target-state and go-to-market use cases, monitoring GTM execution and flagging slippage to program leadership.
  • Engage Technically: Review codebases at a high level for estimation purposes, hold meaningful technical conversations with client engineering teams, and translate between the client’s technical context and OpenZeppelin’s delivery teams.
  • Operate with Rigor: Monitor team performance against key delivery metrics including resource utilization, allocation, and on-time delivery. Use our internal tooling (GitHub, Notion, Slack, HubSpot, and our internal automation system) to streamline workflows and reduce operational overhead.
  • Deliver Unreasonable Hospitality: Every interaction should exceed expectations. You set the standard for exceptional client care across all account touchpoints, and the judgment calls that AI tooling cannot replicate are yours to make.

You have

  • 5+ years of experience in Technical Program Management, Technical Account Management, Customer Success, Engagement Management, Solutions Architecture, or a closely related customer-facing technical role.
  • Proven track record managing complex, multi-stakeholder technical delivery on time and within scope, and managing a book of business with renewal and expansion responsibility.
  • Technical background sufficient to review code at a high level for estimation and to hold credible conversations about smart contract architecture. You do not need to write Solidity, but you should not be lost in a code review.
  • Deep understanding of blockchain ecosystems, L1/L2 infrastructure, and the dynamics of open-source business models. Genuine passion for the space.
  • Solidity or Rust reading proficiency, or hands-on cybersecurity experience.
  • Exceptional relationship-building skills. Clients call you first because they want to, not because they have to.
  • Strong commercial instincts: experience managing renewal cycles, negotiating change orders, and building account expansion narratives.
  • Superb organization and the ability to manage multiple complex engagements concurrently across many stakeholders and time zones.
  • Advanced English; excellent written and verbal communication. Comfortable presenting to a CTO and a CFO in the same meeting.
  • Advanced knowledge of project management and collaboration tools including GitHub, Notion, Linear, Slack, and HubSpot.
  • Comfort working in a fully remote, async-first, globally distributed environment.

  • Familiarity with OpenZeppelin’s product suite (Contracts, Open-Source Tools, Audits, AI Auditor).

This includes but is not limited to gender, race, sexual orientation, religion, national origin and other characteristics that make each one of us unique. In this uniqueness, we find the most value. jobs.title: Product Manager, Onboarding and Growth
jobs.jd_full:
Hi, I’m Geo, Ashby’s VP of Product. I joined Ashby August ‘26; read more about why I joined here. I’m looking for a growth-oriented product manager to help users onboard and expand their usage of the product.

At Ashby, we have a unique approach to building products (more on that below). As a PM, your primary goal is to eliminate frustration and bring delight to our customers. You’ll work with engineers who deeply understand the customer and business problem and own the solution end-to-end. This means that you spend less time writing detailed specs and more time with customers and doing deep product thinking.

Our unique approach is working. We’re growing >100% year over year and have notable customers such as Notion, Linear, OpenAI, Shopify, and Snowflake. Our growth and retention metrics are best in class among our peers. We’re backed by amazing investors like Y Combinator, Elad Gil, Lachy Groom, and many more!

The Challenge

The surface area of our flagship ATS product is growing, and we are launching new products. This means customers are less likely to organically adopt the things that create value for them.

Historically, onboarding has been human-driven by our amazing Customer Success team. And now, we’re ready to productize our learnings. As Ashby grows, we need a single owner who can think deeply about the customer journey and design the product and email experiences that help users achieve their desired outcomes and get the most out of Ashby.

This isn’t just about onboarding individuals. It requires thinking about how to onboard organizations with different roles and stakeholders with different goals. It’s going to be a fun challenge.

What You’ll Be Working On

  • Customer Journey: This role isn’t focused on conversion rate optimization or running A/B tests. Instead, you’ll gain a deep understanding of the entire Customer Journey. Then you’ll design a thoughtful onboarding experience for each role, prioritizing how we can use the product and email to help users at different stages.

  • Product Led Growth: You’ll spearhead our product-led growth motion by working closely with our Customer Success team. They own our human-led onboarding and, in many respects, have designed the first version of this. You’ll also own transactional email (i.e. email triggered by product signals) as it is an extension of the product experience.

  • Adoption Metrics: This is our first-ever product team focused on growth and onboarding, so you’ll be responsible for defining and tracking key metrics to assess whether our onboarding experience helps customers realize value sooner. We have a small but mighty data team that you’ll partner with, but for the most part, you’ll be responsible for defining and analyzing these growth metrics yourself.

  • Product Qualified Leads: You’ll also work closely with our Revenue Operations team to figure out the bridge between product signals that initiate go-to-market activity. You’ll own the definition of a Product Qualified Lead (PQL) and work with the RevOps team to determine how to route them.

  • User Experience: Finally, you’ll own changes to features to make onboarding easier and drive adoption. If you think changing how a given feature works is critical to making onboarding easier, it isn’t off limits. Eventually, we’ll want you to create frameworks and consult with other product teams to help them drive adoption for their product areas.

You could be a great fit if

  • You’ve owned onboarding, expansion, or growth for a B2B SaaS product

  • You have strong product taste, and you think of growth as more art than science

  • You’ve built a growth strategy rooted in principled thinking, research, and data

  • You can show evidence of driving long-term growth results

  • You have an unnatural curiosity and excitement about the end-user and the jobs they do

  • Your written communication skills are excellent

  • You’ve developed product metrics deeply connected to customer value

  • You can point to exceptional relationships with customer success teams

  • You know how to coach and motivate high-agency engineers and drive urgency

We Work Differently

At Ashby, the role of Product Managers is different from what I’ve seen in most product orgs. At a high level, PMs are responsible for shipping impactful product changes at high velocity, consistently and over an extended period. When we think about impactful product changes, our primary goal is to remove frustration and add delight.

At many organizations, PMs are required to write detailed specs that handle every edge case. Designers are required to mock up every pixel. At Ashby, it’s different. We believe individual contributors do their best work when they have a deep understanding of the end user and the business, and ownership of the solution. This is reflected in the engineers Ashby hires: they own projects end-to-end and deeply understand the problems they are solving. PMs are expected to give significant white space in their specs. As a result, PMs can spend less time managing tickets and more time with customers and thinking deeply about the product strategy.

At Ashby, PMs need to be the pace-setters for their product areas. This means they bring a healthy level of impatience and time-paranoia to the table. This does not mean cutting corners or demanding that engineers work unreasonable hours. As a PM, you can help engineers by managing the project scope well, identifying when it’s appropriate to bring in help, or being ruthless about prioritization.

In particular for this role, we think it’s unlikely you’ll be able to A/B test your way to the right solution. We think it’s more likely to build great onboarding through deep thinking. A big part of that is research; you should expect to spend a significant amount of your time researching and understanding customer problems, and then a significant amount of time writing down your thinking.

Finally, Ashby isn’t simply an ATS. Right from the foundations, it was designed to be much more than that. It’s a platform modelled around how organizations (from early-stage startups to massive enterprises) think about recruiting, managing, and retaining top talent. As a PM at Ashby, you should, over time, get familiar with our most common building blocks. You’ll invest not only in product improvements but in platform thinking.

Interview Process

If this also sounds exciting to you, please apply. We review every application and aim to get back to candidates within 2-3 days. For candidates that advance to the interview process here is what you can expect:

  1. Intro Call with Geo (VP, Product) - 30 mins

  2. Product Experience Deep Dive- 45 mins

  3. Assignment

    1. Prepare written assignment (expect to set aside ~2 hours)

    2. Present assignment - 60 mins

  4. Final Round Interview - 2 hours

Mostly focused on cross-functional Interviews to meet more of the team. This is a critical hire for us and a role that will touch a lot of functions - we want to make sure you’ll meet folks you’ll be working closely with

Benefits

  • 10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby —do it when you feel financially comfortable.

  • Unlimited PTO with four weeks recommended per year.

  • Twelve weeks of fully paid family leave in the US. We plan to expand this to employees in other countries as situations arise.

  • Generous equipment, software, and office furniture budget. Get what you need to be happy and productive!

  • $100/month education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval.

  • $250/month tool budget plus access to Claude, Cursor, and Codex with generous token budgets.

  • If you’re in the US, we offer top-tier health insurance for you and your dependents, with 100% of premiums covered by Ashby. In other countries, we provide high-quality supplemental health insurance for you and your dependents, also fully covered by us.

Ashby’s success hinges on hiring great people and creating an environment where we can be happy, feel challenged, and do our best work. We’re being deliberate about building that environment from the ground up. I hope that excites you enough to apply.

To request reasonable accommodations, please contact hiring@ashbyhq.com.

Ashby provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

Ashby is committed to a fair and transparent hiring process. We confirm that this advertisement is for an active, existing vacancy within our organization. jobs.title: Event Project Manager, Life Sciences (US - Remote)
jobs.jd_full:
Mission – Why we exist, what we do, and why we need you

It takes 15 years to move a single drug from the lab to patients, and a huge share of that journey goes into pharma’s pre-launch, launch and commercial activities.

Onomi exists to make pharma and HCP live engagement work better. We give pharma teams one solution to run their in-person and virtual engagements while capturing every interaction in their CRM. We call this “live engagement intelligence” and over 100 pharma companies use our solutions worldwide.

By making events easier to manage and measure, we help pharma create better experiences for HCPs, at a lower cost. Our solution turns complex congress engagements, webinars, standalone meetings, advisory boards and field-led meetings into meaningful connections that drive results for commercial and medical teams.

This position is the ideal role for an agency/pharma meetings project manager or event/meeting planner with experience in congress/convention or medical education planning and execution, and interested in technology, engagement and analytics.

You bring 2+ years of prior experience in congress engagement, KOL and pharma stakeholder management, congress and medical education event project planning and execution. You know the quirks of event approval workflows across Commercial, Medical and Legal Review, not just that they exist, but how they actually slow things down and how to work them.

As a Project Manager, Life Sciences with Onomi, your role will be to lead and execute end-to-end congress, webinar, adboard and medical education event projects both onsite and remote.

This will involve independently building, configuring and launching our suite of live engagement apps (web, mobile, portal, video, AI) using our SpotMe Backstage Content Management System (30%).

You will be professionally managing our customers, and other senior stakeholders with clear, timely communications to enhance the HCP experience adding value across the entire project lifecycle (20%).

As you approach the live event, you will coordinate closely with stakeholders to ensure seamless execution on event day. You will be training faculty, field sales team, booth staff and agencies, and thoroughly reviewing the event apps to guarantee flawless delivery. You will ensure that onsite technology (interaction tracking with apps, microapps, iPads, badge printers) has been fully configured and tested end-to-end. (20%).

For the live event, your responsibilities may vary depending on the type of modules being used but may include ensuring speakers are fully briefed and prepared, whether they’re presenting in a webinar, hosting a virtual session, or speaking onsite at a medical standalone or symposium. You will be responsible for all event operations running smoothly for both virtual and face to face projects (20%).

Following the event, you’ll handle post-event communications, analyze event data, and deliver detailed reports, dashboards and recommendations to the customer, highlighting successes and identifying areas for future improvement (10%).

Objectives - The problems you will solve

During your 6-month ramp-up period:

In your first 3 months, you will onboard, get hands-on with our product and solutions, become familiar with our existing standard operating procedures and get introduced to our services, implementation, product and sales teams. This means you will:

  • Learn Backstage and our product by building and test driving a mobile app and webinar during your first week
  • Building all of your existing and new events in Backstage with minimal supervision, demonstrating quality follow-up emails and no errors in all core modules of the event found during the Project Reviews
  • Getting trained on how we deliver projects at Onomi, develop a deep understanding of the CongressIQ value proposition and experience it by shadowing colleagues in a full project lifecycle in month 1⁄2
  • Managing at least 3 complete congress or life science projects end-to-end - including onsite presence for at least 2 events

In your first 6 months, you have:

  • Become an advocate for our medical education tactics, successfully influencing faculty members to adopt them
  • Gone global, completing an international onsite project with our Europe/APAC team or one of our Europe/APAC customers
  • Mastered the full Onomi playbook by leading and completing a project in each of our core life sciences use cases: webinar, congress, medical education and advisory board
  • Been consistently recognized by clients for delivering best-in-class contributions that elevated event execution and enhanced overall participant experience and outcomes

At 12 months, as a SpotMe product and CongressIQ subject matter expert, you will have grown well beyond delivery into a trusted, multi-format expert who shapes how we run programs:

  • Led an average of ~7 onsite congress or life science projects per quarter (≈28 per year), or 13 remote projects per quarter, or an equivalent mix
  • Started growing the next generation of PMs, supervising 2-5 projects per quarter alongside junior/associate team members
  • Stepped up to Program Lead on one of our brand engagement programs, owning that program objectives are met and that there is continuity across the life of the program
  • Driven new business, by successfully concluding a meaningful upsell deal through one of your referrals and/or joining at least one business development activity with our sales team (webinar, tradeshow, speaking engagement, or RFP pitch)

This role requires frequent travel, out of hours availability and weekend work. About 20 to 40% of your time will be spent traveling onsite. Project planning typically occurs 3-9 weeks in advance, depending on project type.

What you need to be great at

  • Congress, meetings and event project management and process workflows with strong industry expertise: you bring deep expertise in pharma meeting and congress planning and execution, whether from agency or corporate backgrounds. You understand pharma priorities at every stage - before, during, and after events - and
  • translate complex workflows into clear, effective standard operating procedures that keep everything running smoothly and aligned with business goals.
  • Building strong stakeholder relationships with a service-driven mindset: you adeptly engage US and EU customers, KOLs, and medical societies by understanding their unique needs - you navigate and plan every interaction with an extreme sense of service, aligning with corporate pharma stakeholders and KOLs.
  • Influence and escalation: you understand how pharma decision-making works and confidently escalate to leadership when necessary to move projects beyond initial hurdles and bypass common delays and objections.
  • Technical dexterity: you have the ability to effectively and confidently deliver practical solutions (build and ship).
  • Balancing compliance with business needs: you can skillfully balance pharma regulatory compliance and legal review processes with business objectives, navigating and resolving potential roadblocks without compromising project momentum.
  • Product-smart: you understand not every customer request translates directly into a feature. You have the ability to generalize needs and prioritize solutions that deliver true value.

This role sits at approximately the 2-4 year experience level in event or meeting management - or a closely related function.The total compensation for this role ranges from $70,000-$95,000 annually, adjusted based on location, experience and travel frequency.

SpotMe recruits, compensates, and promotes regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, parental status, or veteran status.
